text:
maria_g: Heads up — onboarding a new HF chat model (8.3B) and seeing weird mid-dialog repeats + truncated long-history answers after conversion to Redwood. No converter error, just odd runtime behavior.
ajay: can you paste the model config.json and tokenizer special tokens? sounds like a max_pos/rope mismatch or special token mapping.
maria_g: sure — here's the relevant bits from the HF repo: ```json
{"architectures":["CausalLM"],"max_position_embeddings":2048,"rope_scaling":{"type":"linear","factor":2.0},"num_key_value_heads":32}
```
sofia: is the tokenizer using an eos token that's also in the chat template? that can cause the runtime to treat the prompt boundary as user text if tokens overlap.
maria_g: tokenizer has ``"eos_token":""`` and special_tokens_map includes system and user markers. Chat template is the usual Redwood chat template using <|system|>, <|user|> markers.
kevin_ml: two things to watch: 1) Redwood runtime expects num_key_value_heads to either be absent or match num_attention_heads / heads_per_kv mapping — if the HF model sets kv heads explicitly we sometimes end up with an off-by-one mapping when quantization path rewires the KV cache. 2) rope_scaling with factor !=1 must be translated into Redwood's rope_config.scale param or else the relative position math breaks and you get repeats when sequences exceed original max_pos.
ajay: also check sliding_window / attention_window flags — some HF variants use a sliding window mechanism and set "sliding_window": true (or add custom attrs). If converter drops that, runtime falls back to a static kv cache assumption.
maria_g: converter output (redwood config) shows this: ```json
{"max_position_embeddings":1024,"rope_config":{},"num_key_value_heads":null,"chat_template":"default"}
```
maria_g: so it seems max_position got lowered to 1024 and rope_config is empty — that would explain truncation and rope fallback.
sofia: yep — if max_position decreased, the tokenizer will still produce >1024 tokens for some system+history combos and the runtime will either truncate or start reusing position indices causing repeats.
kevin_ml: quick repro: run a convo with a long system prompt + 3 long messages — compare token lengths before and after conversion. If pre-conversion token_len > redwood_config.max_position_embeddings, that's the bug. Also check that special token ids (bos/eos/pad) are mapped in redwood config.
maria_g: did an evals run — token_len was ~1400 for our standard bench, so >1024. evals-bot: automated eval summary: "long-context-pass rate dropped from 97% -> 41% after conversion; hallucination score +0.27".
ajay: root cause likely converter logic that picks a conservative max_position if rope_scaling present (they probably capped to 1024). We should update converter to honor max_position_embeddings and rope_scaling formulas, and preserve num_key_value_heads if explicitly set.
sofia: interim mitigation: patch the redwood config manually to set max_position_embeddings: 4096 and rope_config: {"type":"linear","factor":"2.0"} and redeploy to dedicated cluster. Also add a test in conversion CI that runs a short token-length check and kv-head parity check.
kevin_ml: for quantization experiments, be careful: quantizing without matching KV head layout will silently corrupt past-key-values — add a debug option that logs per-layer kv cache shape on first request.
maria_g: creating a PR for converter changes and a short runbook for ops to patch configs until we have an automatic fix. Thanks for the quick triage.
evals-bot: note added to model onboarding checklist: verify tokenization length vs redwood max_pos, validate rope_scaling translation, confirm num_key_value_heads parity, and run quick conversation regression eval.
